# Constants

This file exports constants used throughout the application, primarily for pricing and configuration values.

## Overview

This utility file centralizes various constants. Currently, it exports pricing information for different membership tiers, which can be leveraged by modules like `payment.js` and `user.js` to determine subscription costs.

<CardGroup cols={1}>
  <Card title="Membership Pricing" icon="💰">
    Defines monetary values for different membership levels, ensuring consistency across the application.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## Membership Pricing Constants

The `membershipAmount` object provides the cost for each membership tier.

<ParamField name="membershipAmount" type="object">
  An object containing the costs for each membership tier.
  <Expandable title="membershipAmount properties">
    <ParamField name="membershipAmount.silver" type="number">
      The cost of the Silver membership tier.
    </ParamField>
    <ParamField name="membershipAmount.gold" type="number">
      The cost of the Gold membership tier.
    </ParamField>
  </Expandable>
</ParamField>

## Usage Example

Here's how you might use these constants in another part of your application, for example, when processing a payment for a gold membership:

```javascript
// Assuming this code is in src/routes/payment.js or src/services/payment.js
const { membershipAmount } = require('../utils/constants');

const goldMembershipCost = membershipAmount.gold;

console.log(`The cost for a Gold membership is: $${goldMembershipCost}`);

// You would then use this cost in your payment processing logic
// e.g., stripe.charges.create({ amount: goldMembershipCost, ... })
```
